title: Jegog: Gamelan of the Love God

drums.tags: Industrial techno. 130 BPM, 4/4 time signature. A distorted, resonant kick drum provides a heavy, saturated low-end pulse. A metallic, percussive synth sequence runs in sixteenth notes with a high-pass filter sweep. A gritty, overdriven bass synth mirrors the kick's rhythm with short, staccato decays. Industrial foley sounds, including metallic clangs and mechanical whirs, are processed with short room reverb and rhythmic delay. A sharp, white-noise snare hits on beats 2 and 4, layered with a digital clap. Closed hi-hats play a consistent eighth-note pattern with occasional sixteenth-note rolls. Dark, atmospheric pads with slow attack and long release provide a dissonant harmonic layer in the background. The track features a minimalist arrangement focused on rhythmic texture and timbral evolution through filter modulation and distortion saturation.

bass.tags: Industrial techno with dark ambient influences. A distorted, resonant kick drum provides a heavy, thumping pulse at 130 BPM in the key of C minor. A metallic, percussive synth sequence with a short decay and high-pass filtering creates a rhythmic, industrial texture. A low-frequency oscillator modulates a gritty, overdriven bass synth that follows the kick pattern. Atmospheric, dissonant pads with long reverb tails and slow filter sweeps provide a dark, cavernous background. Occasional white noise bursts and metallic foley hits are processed with delay and bit-crushing. The track maintains a steady, driving energy with subtle variations in synth timbre and filter cutoff throughout.
